title: Told my friend we'd see a dinosaur
storyboard: Film: naturalist tells an adult friend 'dinosaur ahead', then points at a peacock far off; real reaction
caption:
Technically, I never lied.

Fossil discoveries over the past few decades have made the evidence overwhelming: birds descend from small feathered theropod dinosaurs. Spot a few on a Muddy Lessons day trail.

Source: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
